# Austek Engineering

> Austek Engineering CC is a steel fabrication and welding firm in Brakpan, Gauteng, South Africa, led by managing director Yehgandra Khunoo. Coded welders, stainless steel fabrication for food, beverage and process plants (the specialisation), boilermaking, pipefitting, structural steel, and plant maintenance, breakdowns and shutdowns, across Gauteng.

- Name: Austek Engineering CC (CK 96/26279/23)
- Address: 15 Milner Avenue, Brakpan, Gauteng, 1541 (East Rand)
- Phone: 084 532 6885 or 083 745 5505
- Email: ykhunoo@yahoo.com
- Area: the whole of Gauteng, including Ekurhuleni, the East Rand industrial belt and Johannesburg. Most work is done on the client's site, plant-side; fabrication is often done off site and then installed.
- Sectors: mostly industrial plant, and also commercial, agricultural and residential work.
- Quotes: send a drawing, a breakdown or a description of the work (a marked-up photo and a phone call is enough to start). Austek replies with a practical approach and a price. No prices are published.
- Not the right firm for: work outside fabrication, welding, boilermaking, pipefitting and structural steel (Austek is not a full mechanical or electrical contractor), or work outside Gauteng.

## Services

- [Stainless steel fabrication and welding](https://austekengineering.co.za/): food-grade (hygienic) stainless fabrication and installation for beverage, food and process plants; stainless and carbon steel welding (MIG, TIG and manual arc) by coded welders; boilermaking (tanks, hoppers, chutes, ducting); process pipework, pump lines and reticulation; structural steel (platforms, walkways, supports); plant maintenance, breakdown repairs and shutdown work.

## Questions answered

- [Steel fabrication in Gauteng: questions buyers ask](https://austekengineering.co.za/faq/): what Austek does, areas, site or workshop, stainless and carbon steel, food-grade work, process pipework, shutdowns, what a quote needs, certificates, and when Austek is not the right contractor.
- [What is a coded welder?](https://austekengineering.co.za/blog/what-is-a-coded-welder/): what coded welding means, what a welder's certificate covers (process, material, thickness and position) and what to ask a fabricator before work starts.
- [304 vs 316 stainless steel: how to choose](https://austekengineering.co.za/blog/304-vs-316-stainless-steel/): why chlorides decide which grade resists pitting, whether both are food grade, and what welding changes.
- [TIG vs MIG welding: which process a plant job needs](https://austekengineering.co.za/blog/tig-vs-mig-welding/): how the two differ and where each suits plant pipework and steelwork.
- [How to prepare for a plant shutdown](https://austekengineering.co.za/blog/plant-shutdown-preparation/): what to close out before the plant stops, what a fabricator needs to quote, and the delays that cost the most time.
- [Pipe spool fabrication: what to build off site, and what to weld in place](https://austekengineering.co.za/blog/pipe-spool-fabrication/): how to split plant pipework between spools fabricated off site and joints welded in place, and what a fabricator needs from the plant to plan it.
- [All guides](https://austekengineering.co.za/blog/)
